features.summary: A source: the one source type every value position takes, and each kind of source a declared member is: a component's or a plugin's property, a method's result, a payload's or a body's field.
features.oracle: The spec itself, where the framework is the authority: D7.1 and D7.2's closed positions and sources, D3.13's conversion and gate 1's P8 forms; and ECMAScript's Number type, which holds no whole number past 9007199254740991 exactly.

promises.page: A resident card whose note is set from the note field of a monitor's alarm, and a monitor whose alarm button raises the alarm with or without its note.
promises.gesture: Click the alarm button that raises the alarm without its note.
promises.outcome: The card shows its empty note state.
promises.opposite: Raised with the note Fall at 3am, the card shows Fall at 3am.
promises.defect: The missing field stops the pipeline, so the card keeps its earlier note, or reaches the card as the text undefined.

promises.page: A pump page whose step sets the pump's rate property from a response field its own JSON converter writes as text.
promises.outcome: The page is refused where the view renders with X7.10's message, naming the field and its own JSON converter.
promises.opposite: The same field with no converter of its own renders, and the pump shows the rate the response holds.
promises.defect: The converter's text reaches the live member, so the pump holds the text in place of its number.

promises.page: A dose page whose step sets a pump's live number from the literal 9007199254740993.
promises.outcome: The page is refused where the view renders with X7.13's message, naming the pump's member and the value.
promises.opposite: The literal 9007199254740991 renders, and the pump shows 9007199254740991.
promises.defect: JavaScript reads the literal as 9007199254740992, so the page renders and the pump shows another dose.

promises.page: An app whose JSON options write numbers as text; a supply search whose found supply's vial count is 5, and a stock counter that holds 1 and adds what its method is passed.
promises.gesture: Search for the supply, then click add.
promises.opposite: A found supply whose vial count is 0 leaves the counter at 1.
promises.defect: The text 5 reaches the method, so the counter shows 15.

promises.page: A pump page whose alarm card shows the alarm's note IfNull the pump's summary, Infusing 50 ml/h, and two buttons that raise the alarm with the note Line occluded or with a null note.
promises.gesture: Click the button that raises the alarm with a null note.
promises.opposite: Raised with the note Line occluded, the card shows Line occluded and not the summary.
promises.defect: The null note reaches the card, so it shows nothing or the text null, or the summary is taken over a held note.

promises.page: A pump page whose Show last alarm button passes the pump's last alarm IfNull the text No alarm to the caption's setCaption method, on a pump whose last alarm reads nothing and one whose last alarm is Air in line.
promises.gesture: Click Show last alarm on the pump with no alarm.
promises.opposite: On the pump whose last alarm is Air in line, the caption shows Air in line.
promises.defect: The method receives undefined, so the caption shows undefined or keeps its earlier text.

promises.page: A resident page whose Check button runs When(weight IfNull 70 > 65) to show Heavy, else Light, over a resident whose weight holds null and one whose weight is 60.
promises.gesture: Click Check on the resident whose weight holds null.
promises.opposite: On the resident whose weight is 60, the badge shows Light: the held weight is compared, not the fallback.
promises.defect: The null weight is compared as null, so the badge shows Light, or the fallback replaces the held 60 and shows Heavy.

promises.page: A fluid chart whose Set target button sets the target from Choose on the order's restriction flag, 1000 ml when it holds and the measured intake when it reads nothing; the intake is a component method that shows how many times it was called.
promises.gesture: Click Set target on an order whose flag holds, then on an order whose flag reads nothing.
promises.outcome: The target shows 1000 ml, then the measured intake, 850 ml, and the intake's call count shows 1.
promises.opposite: Set on the flagged order alone, the call count stays 0.
promises.defect: Both arms are read each time, so the call count shows 2, or the flag that reads nothing takes the first arm and shows 1000 ml.

promises.page: A fluid balance page whose Record button sets the chart's nullable intake property from the intake field widened with OrNull(), and an intake field that can be cleared.
promises.gesture: Type 500 in the intake field and click Record.
promises.opposite: With the field cleared, Record sets the chart's intake to its empty state.
promises.defect: The widened value is dropped or written as text, so the chart keeps its earlier intake or shows the text 500.

promises.page: A fluid balance page whose Check button runs When(intake.OrNull() > target) to show Over target, else Within target, with a target of 1000 ml that can be cleared.
promises.gesture: Type 1200 and click Check, then type 500 and click Check, then clear the target and click Check.
promises.outcome: The badge shows Over target, then Within target, then Within target.
promises.opposite: With the target set back to 400 and an intake of 500, Check shows Over target.
promises.defect: JavaScript's 500 > null holds, so the cleared target shows Over target.

promises.page: A pump page whose Show summary button passes the pump's summary widened to string? to the caption's setCaption method, on a pump whose summary is Infusing 50 ml/h and one with no summary.
promises.gesture: Click Show summary on the pump whose summary is Infusing 50 ml/h.
promises.opposite: On the pump with no summary, the caption shows its empty state.
promises.defect: The widened source writes nothing, so the caption keeps its earlier text.

promises.page: A medication page whose dose badge shows a found chart's status, which the member's own JSON converter writes, IfNull the status a select on the page holds.
promises.outcome: The page is refused where the view renders with X7.11's message, naming the chart's status and its own converter.
promises.opposite: The same IfNull with the fallback DoseStatus.Given, a value the view writes, renders, and the badge shows Given for a resident with no chart.
promises.defect: The two forms join, so the badge holds the converter's text on one arm and the select's text on the other, and a comparison with Given fails on one of them.

promises.page: A medication page whose dose badge shows Choose on a test between a found chart's status, which the member's own JSON converter writes, and the status a select on the page holds.
promises.outcome: The page is refused where the view renders with X7.11's message, naming the chart's status and its own converter.
promises.opposite: The same Choose with the literal arm DoseStatus.Given renders, and the badge shows Given when the test holds.
promises.defect: The two forms join, so the badge holds the converter's text on one arm and the select's text on the other, and a comparison with Given fails on one of them.

promises.page: A medication page whose Check button runs When(chart status IfNull DoseStatus.Given equals DoseStatus.Given) to show Given, else Not given, where the status member is written by its own converter as text, over a resident with no chart found and one whose chart says Missed.
promises.gesture: Search the resident with no chart found and click Check.
promises.opposite: On the resident whose chart says Missed, the badge shows Not given.
promises.defect: The fallback is written as the enum's number while the found status is the converter's text, so the comparison fails and the badge shows Not given.

promises.page: A medication page whose Check button runs When(Choose(test, DoseStatus.Given, chart status) equals DoseStatus.Given) to show Given, else Not given, beside a found chart whose status its own converter writes as Missed.
promises.gesture: Tick the test box and click Check.
promises.opposite: With the box cleared, the badge shows Not given, the found chart's Missed.
promises.defect: The literal arm is written as the enum's number while the found status is the converter's text, so the comparison fails and the badge shows Not given.

verdicts.reason: Its constructor is on the public surface although no subclass outside the assembly compiles, since the read a subclass overrides is internal; the sources are D7.2's closed set, each made by its own door.

features.summary: The page's own URL as a source: a member of the page's class read from the path's placeholder or the query, as the action that rendered the page bound it.
features.oracle: The two hosts' model binders, which bind a query key ignoring case (probe:core-query-key-case, probe:mvc5-query-key-case), as N10.7 states the page's URL reads; and the WHATWG URL Standard's URLSearchParams, whose get matches a key by case (probe:js-query-get-case).

defects.defect: A page opened at ?TAB=medications reads nothing for its Tab member, where both hosts bind the key ignoring case (N10.7).

A query member whose key is absent or whose text does not convert to its type reads something other than its start: ?beds=abc for an int Beds initialized to 2 reads nothing or NaN, where the action bound 2 (N10.7).
A placeholder member is read from the query in place of the path, so a page whose template is /Wards/{Ward}, opened at /Wards/East?ward=West, reads West or nothing for Ward (N10.7).
A read of a member the page's class does not declare, or of the URL by a string that names a key, does not compile: Read takes a member lambda over the page's class, N10.7.

promises.page: A chart page typed by ChartPage, whose Tab member starts as vitals, and whose on-load sets the open tab's text from the page's URL's Tab.
promises.opposite: Opened with no tab key, the open tab reads vitals.
promises.defect: The key is matched by case, so the open tab reads vitals or nothing.

promises.page: A ward page typed by WardPage, whose int Beds member starts as 2, and whose on-load sets the beds text from the page's URL's Beds.
promises.gesture: Open the page at ?beds=abc, then at ?beds=7.
promises.outcome: The beds text reads 2 after the first, and 7 after the second.
promises.opposite: Opened with no beds key, the beds text reads 2.
promises.defect: The unconvertible text reads nothing or NaN, so the beds text is empty or shows NaN after the first.

promises.page: A ward page whose URL template is /Wards/{Ward}, and whose on-load sets the ward text from the page's URL, read with that template, at its Ward.
promises.opposite: Read without the template, the ward text reads West, from the query.
promises.defect: The placeholder is read from the query, so the ward text reads West, or from nowhere, so it is empty.

verdicts.reason: A string names the query key, which ALIS009 refuses, and the browser's URLSearchParams.get matches it by case where both hosts bind it ignoring case; the page's URL is typed by the page's class and read by a member lambda.
